title: Lesson 50 - Acting Outside the Platform: Activation, Data Shares, and Downloads
description: Act on data, specifically acting on data outside the platform: activation to external destinations, downloads and data shares as delivery, and choosing the mechanism that fits a business goal.

questions.question: A marketing team needs a nightly audience pushed to an advertising platform. Which mechanism fits?
options: An activation that publishes the segment to an external platform activation target
A copy field enrichment on the CRM record
A data action to a webhook
questions.explanation: Activation publishes a segment to an external destination; a share is for analytics query access, enrichment is inline, and a data action is event-shaped rather than an audience push.

questions.question: A BI team needs direct query access to harmonized objects and calculated insights without loading copies into its warehouse. Which fits?
options: A data share linked to a data share target
A data action to Amazon Kinesis
A related list enrichment on an account record
questions.explanation: Data shares (including zero copy sharing for Snowflake) expose DLOs, DMOs, and CIOs for external query without copying the data; the other options move audiences or events, not query access.

questions.question: A data share was created in Data 360, but the external Snowflake account cannot see it. What is the most likely cause?
options: The data share is not linked to the data share target
The activation target is in draft state
questions.explanation: Until a data share is linked to a data share target it does not appear in the external system; publishing applies to segments, and record counts or DMO details do not gate visibility of a share.
